blocks.text: I write down what I learn so that I, and anyone starting in QA, don't have to learn it twice.
A public wiki with more than 50 articles on test strategy, API testing, Playwright, CI/CD for QA, performance testing and QA for telecom OSS/BSS.
It starts with a learning path from the fundamentals to automation, and I keep adding to it as I learn.
